title: useNavigationType
summary: Read whether the current application history entry came from POP, PUSH, or REPLACE.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no arguments and requires RouterProvider. The browser navigation integration installed by mountApplication maintains the value.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns the NavigationType string POP, PUSH, or REPLACE. The initial value is POP. This describes history behavior, not whether a loader or action is currently pending.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Read the navigation type where the UI needs to distinguish a replacement from a new history entry.

sections.title: Commit timing
sections.body: History state is published when the navigation integration sees an idle snapshot. With a retained view this can follow the underlying request completion. A standalone RouterProvider without that integration keeps the store’s initial value.
